title: datasette-apps 0.2a0
event_hint: datasette-apps 0.2a0 adds agent app listing and invisible JavaScript smoke-testing tools
problem: Datasette Agent needs a way to discover which apps the user may edit and to validate an app's behavior without relying only on the agent's narrative response or visible manual interaction.
mechanism: The release adds app_list(), which lists apps the current user has permission to edit, and app_debug(), which opens an app in an invisible iframe styled with opacity: 0 and pointer-events: none, then executes agent-provided JavaScript inside the sandboxed iframe. The JavaScript can smoke-test behavior and measure DOM properties such as element dimensions. The article says this uses the context.browser_task() mechanism introduced in datasette-agent 0.4a0.

evidence.claim: datasette-apps 0.2a0 adds app_debug() for opening an app invisibly and testing it with JavaScript.
evidence.condition: Release notes summarized in Simon Willison's Weblog.

evidence.condition: The post describes the release implementation; it does not provide a security audit of the sandbox.

evidence.claim: The JavaScript smoke test can check that an app is working and measure dimensions of different elements.
evidence.condition: Capability claim from the release announcement; no test counts or latency are reported.
